title: Aromatic Moroccan Pork Tagine
description: A tangy, shaggy pork tagine infused with Moroccan spices, wrapped in corn husks for a unique smoky finish.

ingredients.name: Corn husks
ingredients.notes: soaked in hot water until pliable

instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger; sauté until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Toss in pork knuckle and pork katsuramuki slices, browning them on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Stir in carrot and potato pieces and cook for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle the Moroccan spice blend over the meat and vegetables, stirring to coat evenly.
Pour in the chicken broth, bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover the pot and let it simmer for 90 minutes, or until the pork is tender.
Blanch soaked corn husks in hot water until pliable, then wrap the pot tightly with them.
Transfer the wrapped pot to a preheated oven at 160°C (320°F) for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the pot, unwrap the husks, and serve the aromatic pork tagine hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
